pages.title: Problem: "Can't place a block inside a PreFab room"
pages.text: $(bold)Cause$(): The block is on the `prefabRoomBlacklistedBlocks` config list.$(br2)$(bold)Solution$(): $(li)Check `fpscompress-server.toml` → `[prefab]` → `prefabRoomBlacklistedBlocks` $(li)Remove the block from the list, or use a different block $(li)Glob patterns like `mekanism:*` block all blocks from a mod — narrow the pattern if needed

pages.title: Problem: "Simulation aborts with 'blacklisted block(s) found'"
pages.text: $(bold)Cause$(): A blacklisted block exists inside the PreFab room.$(br2)$(bold)Solution$(): $(li)Enter the PreFab room (BUILDING state) $(li)Find and remove the blacklisted block(s) listed in the chat message $(li)Alternatively, remove the block from the config blacklist $(li)Restart the simulation

pages.title: Problem: "Block is blacklisted in PreFab but I can place it in a regular CM room"
pages.text: $(bold)This is intentional.$() The blacklist only applies to PreFab rooms, not regular Compact Machine rooms. If you want to restrict blocks in all CM rooms, configure the Compact Machines mod separately.$(br2)---
